reference_sql:
SELECT p.brand, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
GROUP BY p.brand
alternatives: SELECT p.brand, SUM(s.units) AS units FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09' GROUP BY p.brand

SELECT p.brand, SUM(l.quantity) AS units FROM products p JOIN order_lines l ON l.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09' GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(s.units) AS units FROM sales s JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE s.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09' GROUP BY p.brand
other_way.tradeoff: Starting from sales needs one join less, but sales gives only the UTC day, which this question happens to want.
